recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, nostalgic composition featuring a trio of men in matching collared shirts against a patterned lavender background. The background consists of repeating white silhouettes of athletes in various sports poses, creating a collegiate or 'varsity' theme.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects in the lower two-thirds of the frame
Contrast between the warm peach-toned shirts and the cool lavender background
Repetition of white sport silhouettes creating a textured wallpaper effect
Top-aligned typography centered horizontally above the subjects
coreInvariants: Lavender background with white athletic silhouettes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three male figures positioned in the foreground, filling the bottom half of the frame in a tiered formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face, flanked by the two other members.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold display text at the top, moves down to the central figure, then scans left and right to the other two men.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dedicated to typography and the patterned background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, desaturated pastels with high-key lighting on the subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the main title
Contrast between italicized script and bold sans-serif
Horizontal bars or banners used for secondary information
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A delicate, lowercase script paired with a heavy, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif for a classic mid-century look.
graphicDevices: Horizontal red banner with white border for secondary text
Repeating pattern of sport silhouettes (wrestling, football, golf, basketball)

preserve: Wide tracking of the main title
avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, sturdy, mid-century display feel.
Provides the necessary contrast as a light script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a lavender background with a repeating pattern of small white silhouettes representing various sports like football, wrestling, and golf. In the foreground, place three clean-cut men from the 1960s, smiling, wearing matching peach-colored polo shirts, arranged in a triangular group.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small lowercase script word at the top center. Below it, add a large, bold, wide-tracked uppercase sans-serif title. Beneath the title, place a thin red horizontal banner containing secondary white text.

verificationChecks: Is the background pattern composed of white sport silhouettes?
Are the men wearing matching peach-colored shirts?
Is the main title text widely tracked?
Is the color palette strictly lavender, peach, and white?

adjustableVariables: Background color (could be mint or light blue)
Shirt color (could be yellow or light blue)
Specific sports depicted in the silhouettes
mustRedesign: Any trademarked logos or specific brand names
Exact silhouette shapes to avoid direct copying
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is centered and legible.
Check that the silhouettes are evenly distributed.
Verify the peach and lavender colors do not clash.
Confirm the subjects look like a cohesive group.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a pastel-colored patterned background of thematic silhouettes with a foreground group portrait in matching attire, topped with high-contrast, wide-tracked mid-century typography.
